page_title: VER 0-1 LAZ | Verona v Lazio 11/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Domagoj Bradaric pings in the corner towards the centre of the box and finds Daniel Mosquera (Verona) unmarked, but his free header is woeful and slips well over the bar.
90+5' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) will deliver the corner kick.
90+4' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
90+2' Substitution. Kenneth Taylor will be replaced by Reda Belahyane (Lazio).
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Verona, play can continue.
89' Play continues despite the shouts by some Verona players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Marco Guida interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
88' Nicolas Valentini (Verona) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
88' We are about to witness a subsitution. Al Musrati (Verona) for Cheikh Niasse.
87' The current number of corner kicks is 1:1.

85' Pedro (Lazio) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom right corner. Lorenzo Montipo has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
84' Some neat passing and movement from Verona as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
79' 0 - 1 What bad luck! Victor Nelsson (Verona) got in the way of a pass and unintentionally sent the ball past his own goalkeeper. The score is 0:1.
78' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar.
77' CHANCE! Amin Sarr finds Antoine Bernede (Verona) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the left post!
76' Armel Bella-Kotchap (Verona) is substituted due to injury. Paolo Zanetti gives a chance to Unai Nunez.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Roberto Gagliardini leaves the pitch and Suat Serdar (Verona) comes on.
75' The game is interrupted now, Armel Bella-Kotchap (Verona) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
74' Armel Bella-Kotchap (Verona) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies high over the bar.
73' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
72' Adam Marusic (Lazio) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but Lorenzo Montipo dives superbly to deny him. His shot went towards the left side of the goal.

71' Cheikh Niasse (Verona) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Lazio are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
70' Here is a change. Gustav Isaksen is going off and Maurizio Sarri gives the last tactical orders to Pedro (Lazio).
69' The game has come to an end for Danilo Cataldi. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Nicolo Rovella (Lazio).
69' The total number of attempts is 6:8. 2:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.
68' Paolo Zanetti has decided to substitute Giovane and he is replaced by Daniel Mosquera (Verona).
68' We are about to witness a substitution. Amin Sarr (Verona) is replacing Gift Orban.
67' Gift Orban (Verona) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar.
67' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Giovane (Verona), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
66' Mario Gila (Lazio) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Marco Guida blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Verona in a dangerous position.

65' Gustav Isaksen almost found himself in a promising position after Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.
63' Antoine Bernede (Verona) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
63' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
60' PENALTY APPEAL after Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
60' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
60' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
56' Excellent touch by Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post.
55' Maurizio Sarri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Petar Ratkov (Lazio) replacing Tijjani Noslin.
55' Luca Pellegrini comes off the pitch to be replaced by Manuel Lazzari (Lazio).
55' Half-chance! Martin Frese (Verona) plays a pass into the box, but Ivan Provedel reacts well to snuff out the attack.
54' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post.
49' Giovane (Verona) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

49' The ball is laid off to Martin Frese (Verona) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the bottom left corner and forces Ivan Provedel to make a decent save. Verona earn a corner.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.

45' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well over the crossbar.
44' Roberto Gagliardini (Verona) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. Lazio win a free kick.
43' A pass by Gift Orban (Verona) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

41' Giovane (Verona) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Ivan Provedel gets a hand to it and keeps it out.
37' The Lazio players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
36' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Gustav Isaksen, but Lorenzo Montipo displays great awareness to stop him.
34' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
31' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 2:3. Shots on target – 0:0.
27' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) sends a long cross over to Tijjani Noslin, but Lorenzo Montipo comes forward to gather the ball.
25' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nicolas Valentini (Verona) was quite harsh and Marco Guida didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
25' Neat passing move from Lazio in order to create new attacking opportunities.
23' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
20' Gift Orban (Verona) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
20' An attempted cross from Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) is cleared.
18' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
18' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) takes a short corner kick.
17' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) tries to find Matias Vecino with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
16' Ball possession – 25:75.
15' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lorenzo Montipo intercepts the ball.
14' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
13' Giovane (Verona) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
11' Giovane (Verona) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
8' Poor challenge! Antoine Bernede (Verona) is penalised for tripping and Marco Guida blows his whistle.
7' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) should have done it better. He won the ball from the resulting free kick, but fired well wide of the right post.
6' This is a yellow card! Armel Bella-Kotchap (Verona) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.

4' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders. Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) can bury his head in the sand! He misses the rebound from inside the penalty box as he plants a header high over the bar! A typical school boy’s error!
2' Marco Guida blows the whistle, Giovane (Verona) is penalised for a foul.
1' A cross from Martin Frese (Verona) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Lazio will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Marco Guida.
